decisions.summary: Closed exact source types, transparent aliases, nominal enum domains, structural OBJECT schema identity, reference value/identity contexts, metadata access, positional calls, indexes, and loop-local OUTPUT reads. String decoding, material identities and exact temporal values are closed in types_v0.1.0.json and mirrored prose.
Closed evaluation order, short circuit, sentinel propagation, strict equality, empty/duplicate collection behavior, quantifiers, reductions, signature metatypes, and common unit-mismatch diagnostics.

Closed self-contained Core GLOB and REGEX profiles: syntax, decoded escapes, scalar classes, path segments, anchors, quantifiers, flags, whole-input matching, exact value identity and diagnostics; no unspecified external dialect is normative.

Closed expression fragments, predicate bindings, comparison criteria, group shape, read-range schema/units/bounds, reference-only validation schemas and same-family STRING/LIST append content; all 39 operation contracts and nine result schemas remain aligned.

Closed structural graph activation/order/cycles, sibling edges, parallel independence, loop instances, continuation, singular OUTPUT ownership, retry/fallback publication, selected check scheduling and concrete-target applicability, root completion, aliases, lifecycle and dynamic diagnostic demand.

The owner authorized completion of the bare-language specification. Retain WORKSPACE solely as an explicit language path-base/access declaration and retain abstract standard-library effect contracts. UI, workspace/project applications, provider/agent products and every executable language implementation remain outside Core completion. No host implementation is a required normative artifact.

Registries, EBNF, lexical/type/semantic/library prose, examples and the 799-entry requirements catalog plus 66 descriptive decision witnesses agree under fresh focused checks. Cross-surface parity and explicit reviewed-rule checks are enforced by validate_language_contracts.py.

Fresh read-only lexical/forms, expression/library, and graph/check/lifecycle/OUTPUT reviews resolved every definite finding. Follow-up review confirmed processing-order alignment and detection of the multiline literal registry/prose contradiction. No outstanding semantic blocker was identified in these bounded reviews.

Fresh focused filesystem, text, structured, grammar, registry and catalog checks pass; 514 language-contract checks have no violations. Fourteen representative isolated static contract mutations are detected, 15 bounded source fixtures match, and six supplementary source-hygiene probes match. These checks do not execute LCL; final integrity and release validation follow closure.
